caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair positioned at an angle, with its backrest to the left and the seat facing slightly to the right. The chair features four legs, two of which are straight, while the two at the front are turned with decorative details. The seat is broad, slightly curved, and shows areas of lighter and darker wood grain, giving it a worn appearance. The backrest is short and arched, supported by four evenly spaced vertical spindles that connect to the seat. The wood of the chair is depicted in shades of muted brown and beige, with subtle greenish and yellowish undertones, emphasizing the weathered texture. The background is plain with an off-white color, and there are no additional objects or elements in the composition.
title: Shaker Dining Chair
